planets.name: HIP 41378 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of HIP 41378 with a 31.7-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: HIP 41378 c was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 6 planets known around HIP 41378. Its orbit and size follow Lund et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
